text_block_list.text: One day in town, I happened to spot Jungle Pocket and Agnes Tachyon together—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come now, come now! Anywhere is fine,
so hurry along to a place where some
interesting data might be obtained!
choice_data_list: ...Did you get dragged into a weird experiment?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, completely dragged in.
Somethin' about emotions and phys'cal function? Or whatever?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She even slapped some kinda machine on me,
I don't get what's goin' on at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—During the current conversation... Hmm,
no notable fluctuations in the electrocardiogram, I see.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it ain't like she's the type
to listen even if I complain anyway!
Deeply agreeing that she had a point, the best advice I could offer was—
choice_data_list: How about observing Tachyon in return?
Why not just spend the time without worrying about it?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what's that? Sounds hilarious!
Approved!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! I always wanted to see
this geek crack up laughing like an idiot for once~~♪

text_block_list.name: Comedy Trio
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone~~!!!
Thanks for having us~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmph, a comedy live show...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The comedians here are top-tier, so it's a favorite of mine. Well, just shut up and watch!!

text_block_list.name: Comedy Trio
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHA!! That was awesome!!
How was that? Pretty hilarious, right Tachyon?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I see, a three-person setup allows the bystander in the dialogue to transition into an intruder, enabling a three-act structure... Fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Three-act structure...? What the hell are you even laughin' at...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, Pocket-kun's data is also intriguing.
Her body is energized, yet her mental state is rather relaxed—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Revitalizing mind and body through "laughter", is it?
Fufu, this could perhaps be applied to research for a new training regimen—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(—This girl... Turnin' even comedy into research material for racing... She's nuts...
...For real, she's unhinged—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (She's so unhinged it's freakin' hilarious...!!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what's that? Sounds hilarious!
Approved!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it, I always wanted to see this geek crack up laughing like an idiot for once~~.

text_block_list.name: Comedy Duo
text_block_list.text:
Hello everyone~~,
thanks for having us~~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmph, a comedy live show...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: The comedians here are top-tier, so it's a favorite of mine. Well, just shut up and watch!!

text_block_list.name: Comedy Duo
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!!
How was that? Pretty hilarious, right Tachyon?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Fufufu, intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A riddle story where the true identity of the dish the man ate in the skit remains unknown until the end...
It provides ample room for deep analysis, does it not?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Nah, that was just a gag meant to make you go "Like that exists!"!
It ain't somethin' you're supposed to think hard about.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What?! If it possessed the properties described, I thought it would be optimal as a pre-race meal...!
Are you telling me it was merely a MacGuffin?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, perhaps I shall synthesize it myself.
If I combine this and that—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
(—This girl... Connectin' even a stand-up routine to her research topics...
She's outta her mind... For real, she's unhinged—)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (She's so unhinged it's freakin' hilarious...!!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Guess that works too!
Let's head somewhere we can kick back and relax without mindin' her.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Somewhere spacious and chill, huh?
Then "that place" is our only choice—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: When you hit the zoo, lions gotta come first! Haha, you're always sleepin' no matter when I visit~. Well, I love naps too, so I totally get ya!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Lions sleep for over 15 hours a day... While the prevailing theory is energy conservation for hunting, could it be Pocket-kun also does so for running...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh, look, the gorilla chest-beating thing! Pretty flashy, what's that about? I get the urge to randomly shout sometimes too, though...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hmm, commonalities between Pocket-kun's roar and chest-beating...? If I recall, studies show chest-beating is a peaceful means of self-assertion—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...Are you actually an animal lover? You sure know a heck of a lot about 'em.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Understanding the ecology and anatomy of all living organisms is an indispensable foundation for my research, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: One could certainly say I "love" them, if you consider that both horse girls and humans are, in a sense, animals!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, my favorite animal of all is a "test subject", though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fufu, there are so many guinea pigs here...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (Is everything she lays eyes on seriously nothin' but "research material" for racing to her? She's wild, crazy wild—!)

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: (She's so unhinged it's freakin' hilarious...!!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm. I have acquired sufficient general data from you. Thank you for your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh! Then let's hit the freestyle track!! Let's go for a run together right now—!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I must decline. I have preparations for the next experiment to attend to. ...Excuse me.
One day, as I passed by Agnes Tachyon's laboratory—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Tachyon, ain't you gonna research me anymore? You can observe me tons while racin', ya know? You might even get new ideas!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: C'mon, race! Let's race!! Pleeease! Ta~chyo~n~!
Jungle Pocket was seen badgering Agnes Tachyon... an exact reversal of the scene from the other day.
